title: Weaver onboarding: bring your data in

Files.dc.html.title: 2c · Your own files, read by Niva

t1.text: Weaver onboarding: bring your data in

n1.text: Niva proposes, people approve. Every suggestion shows its evidence and how sure it is. Nothing is saved until Confirm, and a load can be undone for 30 days.

n2.text: One engine for every source. Files, connectors, templates and photos all land in the same staging, checks, matching, preview and undo. A connector is a file that fetches itself.

n3.text: Right-size the move. Load the last 7 years of giving, keep older years as yearly totals, start with people and giving, and add modules later.

n4.text: Nothing about children reaches an AI service (owner decision D2, 2026-10-09). Photos are read on Weaver's own servers, and columns about children are never shown to Niva.
